source_caption_text:
Never forget when Rick Ross tried to moonwalk 😭

Rick Ross’ moonwalk is still one of the funniest hip-hop moments from the 2013 era. It came from Young Scooter’s “Colombia (Remix)” video, right after Ross delivers the line, “MJ moonwalking on them white squares.”

Ross then tries to actually moonwalk across the checkerboard floor, but the move is nowhere near as smooth as Michael Jackson’s. The stiff little shuffle only lasts a few seconds, but that was more than enough for the clip to become a meme.

It’s been over a decade and people still bring it up whenever Ross’ funniest moments come around. The confidence makes it even better because he fully committed to the move like he was killing it

#rickross #rap #funny
